name: modular square root by correcting a guess with powers of a non-residue
mechanism: write the prime minus one as an odd part times a power of two, form an initial guess from the odd part, and repeatedly fix the guess by multiplying with appropriate powers of a known non-residue until its square matches

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Tonelli–Shanks algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:

requires: a quadratic non-residue (found by random trial)
